title: Trucki Devices Configuration
description: JSON schema for Trucki-Stick configuration (T2SG/T2MG/T2HG) used by trucki_http_mqtt.py.

items.title: Trucki Device
items.description: Configuration for one Trucki-Stick (any of the T2SG/T2MG/T2HG variants; the bridge publishes whatever fields it finds dynamically).

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier for the Trucki stick used in MQTT topics and Home Assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Display name for the Trucki stick in Home Assistant.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Trucki stick.

port.title: HTTP port
port.description: TCP port of the stick's local web server.

live_path.title: Live status path
live_path.description: HTTP path that returns the stick's live measurements as flat JSON (confirmed default: /jsonlive, polled every TRUCKI_POLL_INTERVAL_S).

once_path.title: Config/info path
once_path.description: HTTP path that returns the stick's configuration/info data as flat JSON (confirmed default: /jsononce, polled as diagnostic on a longer interval). Password fields in the response are never published.

auth_user.title: HTTP auth username
auth_user.description: Username for HTTP basic auth against the stick's web server, if ADMIN_PASS is set on the stick. Leave empty if the stick has no admin password configured.

auth_password.title: HTTP auth password
auth_password.description: Password for HTTP basic auth, matching auth_user.

via_device.title: Parent device
via_device.description: Home Assistant device identifier this stick is linked to via 'via_device' (e.g. 'energy_node', or a co-located battery_soc device id if this stick and a battery bank are physically the same unit).
